title: stage's Responses grid
howToOpen: Open the event, click the stage's tab (e.g. RFQ); the Responses sub-tab opens first.

reviewed.note: Columns come from the stage's template (schema → sheets.inline_components.widgets); creator columns sit in the frozen left pane, each bidder's columns under the bidder's name. Participation reads bid_placed / invited from bidders_delivery_stats (participantStats.jsx).

groups.title: The stage's status chip agrees with the stage's status and bidding window in the API
The Responses grid has a column for every bidder and shows every quoted value exactly as the API returns it

fields.label: Bid total
fields.note: Shown as the bidder's Sum Total / Total Amount.

groups.title: The Participation counter shows bids placed out of vendors invited, as the API counts them
The savings strip shows the savings amount and percentage the API computed
No screen of the event looks fine while a request behind it failed, and none reports an error while its requests succeeded
